commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

90+3' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) jumps high inside the box to head the rebound towards the right side of the goal, but James Trafford pulls off an amazing reflex save to keep the ball out of the net. Nice goalkeeping skill! The ball goes out of play and Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by James Trafford.
90+1' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Joao Palhinha walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kevin Danso (Tottenham).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Phil Foden (Manchester City) produces a poor lofted pass into the penalty box. His attempt is easily thwarted by the defence.
88' Peter Bankes has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham). That's a free kick to Manchester City.

87' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) latches onto a short pass from Lucas Bergvall inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
86' The corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is cleared away by the defence.
86' Substitution. Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mohammed Kudus walks off.
86' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.

85' A nice pass finds Phil Foden (Manchester City) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic low shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Guglielmo Vicario pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
83' Nathan Ake swings the cross over. Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.

82' A cross by Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
81' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
79' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
78' Substitution. Brennan Johnson did his best and is replaced by Wilson Odobert (Tottenham).
78' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) replaces Richarlison.
76' Rodri (Manchester City) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
76' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
75' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Nico will be replaced by Rodri (Manchester City).
75' Here's the change. Oscar Bobb leaves the pitch and Phil Foden (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
74' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) commits a foul and Peter Bankes immediately signals a free kick.
71' This is a yellow card! Richarlison (Tottenham) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
71' The referee is firm and issues Nico (Manchester City) a deserved yellow card.
70' A corner kick by Manchester City is thwarted by the well prepared Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham).
69' Manchester City can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester City will take a corner.
69' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
68' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make.
66' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
64' Richarlison (Tottenham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

62' Mohammed Kudus delivers a perfect cross for Richarlison (Tottenham), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.

61' Richarlison (Tottenham) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
60' Peter Bankes interrupts the game. One of the players from Manchester City won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Tottenham earn a free kick.
59' Richarlison (Tottenham) sprays a pass out to Brennan Johnson, but he can't beat his man inside the box.

57' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.

56' Richarlison (Tottenham) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and James Trafford makes a comfortable save.
54' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Omar Marmoush is replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Cherki trots off the pitch and is replaced by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
53' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and it's Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
51' The Manchester City players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
49' The ball is cleared after Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Nathan Ake (Manchester City) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+8' The match has reached half-time.

45+7' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Rayan Cherki just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
45+7' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Rayan Cherki (Manchester City).
45+5' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
45+5' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
45+2' 0 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Joao Palhinha (Tottenham), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:2.
45+1' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) takes the corner.
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
45' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
42' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is able to continue to play.
42' Referee Peter Bankes signals NO PENALTY for Tottenham after a VAR review!
40' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Tottenham! Let's see what he decides.
39' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
35' 0 - 1 Goal! Richarlison provides Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
35' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Peter Bankes is going to take a look using VAR.
35' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
34' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
33' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Peter Bankes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
32' Neat passing move from Tottenham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Guglielmo Vicario pulls off a great save to deny Omar Marmoush (Manchester City), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
27' A pass by Rico Lewis (Manchester City) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball has crossed the sideline. Tottenham are taking a throw-in.
26' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Tottenham.
25' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
25' The total number of attempts is 3:2.
23' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Rayan Ait Nouri limps off the pitch to be replaced by Nathan Ake (Manchester City).
21' Rayan Ait Nouri (Manchester City) picks up an injury.
21' A pass by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
19' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.

18' A neat pass finds Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the left side of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario denies him with a good save.
18' Rayan Ait Nouri (Manchester City) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
15' Rayan Ait Nouri (Manchester City) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
14' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Guglielmo Vicario.
12' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) commits a rough foul. Peter Bankes stops the game and makes a call.
10' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.

9' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
9' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Pedro Porro (Tottenham), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.
9' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
8' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) jumps into a tackle and Peter Bankes signals a foul. Tottenham will take a free kick.
5' Nico (Manchester City) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
3' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Peter Bankes no option but to blow his whistle.
2' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Peter Bankes will supervise the game today.
